states.text: MAX web messenger - chat list is shown (no conversation open). Left icon rail x~0-70 (centre of each above its label): Новые ~[38,196], Каналы ~[38,262], Контакты ~[38,353], Звонки ~[38,419], Настройки ~[38,994]. Chat-list column x~70-520: header 'Чаты' y~112, search field 'Найти' y~163, then chat rows (avatar + name + last-message preview + time). Main area x~540+ is empty blue. Click a chat row (its name) to open the conversation.

MAX web messenger - a conversation is open. Thread header (top of main area, x~560+, y~102) shows the contact name and last-seen (e.g. '3 ч назад' / 'онлайн'). Message thread scrolls above the composer. Composer bar at the bottom (y~985-1035): attach x~870, emoji x~1430, camera x~1475, mic x~1520; the input field centre is ~[930,1008] (placeholder 'Сообщение'). Click it, type, then press Enter OR click the round blue Send button [1522,1010]. Right-click a message -> context menu (see state message_menu). NOTE: the composer sits below the router's OCR cap, so its text is usually not in ocr_scope -> message_input/send_button are coordinate controls.

Context menu opened by right-clicking a message bubble in MAX. It is a Chrome-internal popup (NOT a separate HWND; invisible to win_list_hwnd and to the UIA tree) -> locate items with screen_find(kind='text', ...). Items for your own message, top->bottom: 'Отметить непрочитанным', 'Скопировать текст', 'Выбрать', 'Удалить' (red). For a message from the contact there is also 'Пожаловаться' before 'Удалить'. Escape closes it. The menu appears next to the clicked bubble, so item Y positions shift with the bubble; the text locators below are position-independent.

Confirmation dialog shown after choosing 'Удалить' in the message context menu. Layout (window maximized 1920x1080, dialog centred on the window): title 'Удалить сообщение?' y~496; checkbox 'Удалить у всех?' y~551 (CHECKED by default); buttons row y~630 -> 'Удалить' (left) and 'Не удалять' (right). Deleting is irreversible; confirm with the user before clicking confirm_delete.
